title: Staffing check: request from delivery scheduling, response from teachermodel

partner.description: Optional, additive within major 2 (increment 3, W11). The partner organisation the delivery is for. A clearance scoped to a partner covers only a request that names it.

region.description: Optional, additive within major 2 (increment 3, W11). The region the delivery is in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, optionally with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision: IE, US-CA). A clearance scoped to regions covers only a request that names one of them.

reasons.description: Why a verdict is warn or block. What delivery scheduling receives is drawn from a fixed vocabulary (decision 0005: scheduling sees clearance status only): "not cleared" for a block; "clearance expiring" and/or "recheck due" for a warn; and, for an ok that rests on a staffing override (the head of training overriding a block, for exactly the instructor, unit, mode and date of the request), "override tm:override/<id>". The detailed reasons (the bench decision, a retired framework, a scope, day counts, and what an override overrode as "overridden: <reason>") are produced only for the training function (teachermodel staffing-check --detail).
